## Qpu.Application.Shor

### `all_shor`

Claimed by Tsvetan Rouschev as the author's own statement, by this name and as stated.

```lean
period shorBase shorModulus % coins = 0
```

### `shor`

Claimed by Tsvetan Rouschev as the author's own statement, by this name and as stated.

```lean
period shorBase shorModulus % coins = 0 ∧
  half shorBase shorModulus < shorModulus - seed ∧
    seed < _root_.gcd (half shorBase shorModulus - seed) shorModulus ∧
      _root_.gcd (half shorBase shorModulus - seed) shorModulus < shorModulus ∧
        _root_.gcd (half shorBase shorModulus - seed) shorModulus *
            _root_.gcd (half shorBase shorModulus + seed) shorModulus =
          shorModulus
```

### `shor_cases`

Claimed by Tsvetan Rouschev as the author's own statement, by this name and as stated.

```lean
period 2 35 = 12 ∧
  _root_.gcd (powMod 2 6 35 - 1) 35 = 7 ∧
    _root_.gcd (powMod 2 6 35 + 1) 35 = 5 ∧
      period 2 77 = 30 ∧
        _root_.gcd (powMod 2 15 77 - 1) 77 = 7 ∧
          _root_.gcd (powMod 2 15 77 + 1) 77 = 11 ∧
            period 2 7 = 3 ∧
              period 2 7 % coins = 1 ∧ period 3 7 = 6 ∧ powMod 3 3 7 + 1 = 7 ∧ _root_.gcd 14 21 = 7 ∧ 2048 = 2 ^ 11
```
